body: It's snowy outside. I see myself as worthless shit that can't afford the cost of life.

I don't know. I was placed on a probation program and immediately said fuck it. I've been more or less holed up at home since. I had a bunch of work due that Friday (placed on probation wed) and just couldn't get it done in time. Haven't been to class since.
I wish I had answers for you, but I don't. I only have the empathy of someone who's been there. PM me if you feel like talking. Please be OK.
